title: 35m Explorer Yacht Fox Listed for Sale
description: Explore the 35m explorer yacht Fox, a 2024 masterpiece by Pendennis Shipyard, now for sale at €18 million, offering luxury and adventure.
html:
The 35-meter explorer yacht Fox, constructed by Pendennis Shipyard in the UK and delivered in 2024, is now on the market for €18 million.
Fox features a steel hull combined with an aluminium superstructure, built in accordance with RINA commercial class regulations. The exterior styling results from a partnership between Tansu Yachts and Pendennis, while Q London crafted the interior design.

Accommodation and Layout

Fox provides accommodation for up to ten guests across five cabins, including a full-beam owner’s suite and four guest staterooms on the lower level, each equipped with ensuite bathrooms. The yacht is managed by a crew of seven for smooth operation and high-quality service.

Performance and Technical Features

Fitted with twin Caterpillar C18 ACERT engines for a combined output of 2,080 HP, Fox can cruise at 12 knots and reach top speeds between 14 and 16 knots. The vessel has an approximate range of 3,000 nautical miles at cruising speed. ABT TRAC fin stabilisers enhance comfort both underway and at anchor, and Simrad navigation equipment ensures precise handling and navigation.

Deck Spaces and Explorer Capabilities

Purpose-built as an expedition explorer yacht, Fox showcases a sturdy exterior and boasts a 103.5-square-meter aft deck. This space holds two 7.5-meter tenders, an array of water toys, and submersibles. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a DJ booth, al fresco dining, a bar, and a glass-enclosed sky lounge featuring a terrace with BBQ facilities and extra dining areas.

Operational History and Purpose

Since its launch in spring 2024, Fox has undertaken journeys throughout the Mediterranean. The yacht is named in honor of Falmouth scientist Robert Were Fox the Younger. Engineered as a compact yet robust explorer, Fox targets owners aiming to reach distant locations with comfort and confidence.

Fox combines solid expedition features with contemporary amenities on board. The yacht is presently offered for sale at €18 million.
